result.topic_en: Numerical work on the degree-7 equation x^7 - 28x^4 + 280 + 200(cos φ) = 0, with the constant terms rewritten in complex form as 280 ± √39200 and ∓ i√19200 and evaluated to decimals.

methods.what: Degree-7 equation in x with a parameter given by the cosine of an angle φ
The constant term rewritten in complex form using cos φ and i sin φ times a square root (280^2 - 200^2 = 38400)
Auxiliary square root related to the ratio 280/200 = 1.4
Numerical evaluation of square roots: √39200 ≈ 197.9898987, and a value 138.9244399 written beside √19200 (this value actually equals √19300)
